ok.de: Nach hope folgt not direkt: I hope not.
ok.en: After hope, not follows directly: I hope not.

wrong.en: There is no that before not.

wrong.de: Die Verneinung heißt hier not: I hope not.
wrong.en: The negative here is not: I hope not.

ok.de: Es heißt did the same: Vor same steht the.
ok.en: It is did the same: before same you need the.

wrong.de: Vor same steht the: the same.
wrong.en: Before same you need the: the same.

wrong.de: Es heißt did the same, nicht did it.
wrong.en: It is did the same, not did it.

ok.de: Kosten werden mit Kosten verglichen: those of the old plan.
ok.en: Costs are compared with costs: those of the old plan.

wrong.de: Im Vergleich steht those of statt des Nomens costs.
wrong.en: In the comparison those of stands instead of the noun costs.

wrong.de: Costs ist Plural, deshalb those of, nicht that of.
wrong.en: Costs is plural, so those of, not that of.

ok.de: Am Ende muss to nicht fehlen: Yes, I would like to.
ok.en: At the end to has to stay: Yes, I would like to.

wrong.de: Nach would like muss to stehen bleiben.
wrong.en: After would like, to has to stay.

wrong.de: Das Verb join entfällt, nur to bleibt.
wrong.en: The verb join is dropped, only to stays.
